preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 200000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5) representing the number of operations.

preconditions.expression:
all(len(line.split()) == 1 and line.split()[0] in ('1', '2', '3') or (line.split()[0] == '1' and len(line.split()) == 3) or (line.split()[0] == '2' and len(line.split()) == 2) or (line.split()[0] == '3' and len(line.split()) == 1) for line in stdin.split('
')[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines describes an operation: type 1 (add x_i to first a_i elements) with two integers a_i, x_i, type 2 (append k_i) with one integer k_i, or type 3 (remove last element) with no additional integers.

preconditions.expression:
all(1 <= int(t_i) <= 3 for t_i in [line.split()[0] for line in stdin.split('
')[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each operation type t_i is an integer between 1 and 3 inclusive.

preconditions.expression:
all(1 <= int(a_i) for line in stdin.split('
')[1:] if line.split()[0] == '1' for a_i in [line.split()[1]])
preconditions.description: For type 1 operations, a_i is a positive integer (1 ≤ a_i).

preconditions.expression:
all(-1000 <= int(x_i) <= 1000 for line in stdin.split('
')[1:] if line.split()[0] == '1' for x_i in [line.split()[2]])
preconditions.description: For type 1 operations, x_i is an integer with absolute value ≤ 10^3.

preconditions.expression:
all(-1000 <= int(k_i) <= 1000 for line in stdin.split('
')[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2' for k_i in [line.split()[1]])
preconditions.description: For type 2 operations, k_i is an integer with absolute value ≤ 10^3.

postconditions.expression:
all(len(stdout_line.split()) == 1 and 0 <= float(stdout_line) <= 1e6 for stdout_line in stdout.split('
') if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each operation, the output is a single line containing the average of the sequence after the operation, formatted as a floating-point number with absolute or relative error ≤ 10^-6.
The output contains exactly n lines, one for each operation, with no empty lines.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= len(sequence) <= n + 1 for sequence in [parse_sequence_after_operation(i) for i in range(n)])
postconditions.description: For each operation i, the sequence length is between 0 and n + 1 (initial length 1, max length after n operations is n + 1).

postconditions.expression:
all(sum(sequence) / len(sequence) == float(stdout_line) for sequence, stdout_line in zip([parse_sequence_after_operation(i) for i in range(n)], stdout.split('
')) if len(sequence) > 0)
postconditions.description: For each operation i, the average of the sequence after the operation equals the output line's value, computed as sum(sequence) / len(sequence).
